steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
I’ve just listened to a really interesting programme on the radio.

Present Perfect: it finished a moment ago and it still matters now. No time word.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
He lost his mother when he was a boy.

Past Simple: the sentence says when. Finished time, finished action.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
He has recently found her again after twenty-five years.

Present Perfect: the result is true now — he has her back.

steps.prompt: Some of these sentences tell you exactly when it happened. Which tense do they use?
options: Present Perfect — have / has + past participle
Past Simple — lost, fell, woke up
steps.answer: Past Simple — lost, fell, woke up
